name: TSC22 domain family member 2

function.text: TSC22D2 is the approved symbol for TSC22 domain family member 2. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in negative regulation of cell cycle; regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Breast carcinoma; Colorectal carcinoma; Cutaneous melanoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: TSC22D2 encodes TSC22 domain family member 2. Its functions include negative regulation of cell cycle and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TSC22D2 have been reported in breast carcinoma, cutaneous melanoma, and colorectal carcinoma.
